facts.business: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited is a leading global automobile manufacturer offering a diverse portfolio of cars, SUVs, and electric vehicles in India, and owns Jaguar Land Rover which operates four British luxury brands globally.
key_risks: Cyber incident at Jaguar Land Rover impacting production and working capital
Geopolitical uncertainties including West Asia crisis and trade agreement dynamics
Stagflation risks - falling output coupled with rising inflation
facts.related_party_note: Details of significant investments in subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates disclosed in Note 45; loans to subsidiaries for capex and general corporate purposes disclosed in financial statements
